messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up from today's quant onboarding: v3.2-float4 shows big throughput wins but we have a mixed signal on the "factuality" slice (short factual answers).
arjun: saw the dashboard ping. numbers?
zoe: baseline v3.1-fp16 -> v3.2-f4; slice n=3600; delta_mrr=-0.012 p=0.037; delta_factual=-0.025 p=0.009; latency p50 -27%; cost/token -31%. Link: https://console.redwood/testing/runs/2026-02-25/1747770001
pavel: interesting — semantic/factual metric stronger than MRR. our gates currently treat metrics separately and hard block on any critical metric p<0.05. that would autofallback here.
arjun: given strong infra wins, I don't want an immediate block for a single metric. propose we build a "fuzzy risk score" that aggregates normalized metric deltas with tunable weights and an economics offset. thresholding on the score could trigger replicate or autofallback.
zoe: love the idea. sketch: risk = w1*norm(mrr_delta) + w2*norm(factual_delta) + w3*norm(em_delta) - econ_boost, where econ_boost = clamp(alpha*(latency_pct + cost_pct), 0, cap). If risk > T1 -> replicate_then_manual; if risk > T2 -> autofallback.
eval-bot: auto-eval: slice=factual(short); n=3598; delta_mrr=-0.0123; p_mrr=0.037; delta_factual=-0.0248; p_factual=0.009; latency_p50_improve=27; cost_token_improve=31; notes=prompt-template set with factual-check suffix; semantically consistent failures concentrated on time-sensitive facts.
arjun: example config block (proto):
```
"fuzzy_gates": {
  "weights": {"mrr": 0.4, "factual": 0.5, "exact": 0.1},
  "norm_bounds": {"lower": -0.10, "upper": 0.10},
  "economics": {"alpha": 0.01, "cap": 0.15},
  "thresholds": {"replicate": 0.06, "autofallback": 0.12},
  "actions": {"replicate_then_manual": true, "hard_autofallback": true}
}
```
zoe: questions: 1) how to normalize deltas across metrics? 2) how to pick weights? 3) auditable and deterministic decisioning needed for compliance.
pavel: for normalization use historical z-score ranges per metric (rolling 90-day percentile clamp) so we avoid unit mismatch. weight selection should be conservative: start with product-owner suggested weights, then run a retrospective on past 500 runs to tune for target FAR/FRR. we must log the raw inputs, normalized values, econ_boost, and the final score in the audit record.
arjun: also propose a "trust decay" for new metrics: if factual metric is new or in beta, multiply its contribution by a decay factor that ramps up over N runs. avoids overreacting to novel signals.\e val-bot: (typo-correction) historical retrospective analysis: applying a 0.5 weight to factual on a held-out log would have prevented 9 true regressions but also added 14 extra replicates historically. tradeoff depends on operational cost budget.
zoe: operational concerns: too many replicate jobs delay promotions. we should tier: small risk -> quick 1h replicate; medium -> 3h; high -> immediate hard_autofallback plus page. propose mapping thresholds to replicate durations.
arjun: agreed. also include a manual-override tag for release leads for economics-exception cases so they can accept higher risk if infra wins are critical. must require a short justification string stored in the decision log.
pavel: security/compliance: decisions and raw metrics must be immutable once recorded. store signed decision objects in rollout-audit-bucket and surface them in the console. add an RCA link requirement for any manual override.\e val-bot: suggested decision record schema: run_id, slice, metrics_raw, metrics_norm, econ_boost, risk_score, threshold_hit, action_taken, actor, justification_url.\e val-bot: historical note: replicated_then_manual flows resolved 62% as false-positive regressions (i.e., replicate did not reproduce) and prevented 38% real regressions. replicate average runtime 2.3h historically.
zoe: action items: 1) prototype fuzzy_gates in rollout-config as opt-in flag; 2) run retrospective simulation on last 500 onboarding runs to pick weights and thresholds (pavel + arjun); 3) add audit-write and console wires (pavel); 4) add replicate-duration mapping and rate-limit replicates to avoid backlog (ops). I'll open a PR with a prototype config and simulation plan.
arjun: I'll run the retrospective and post a short notebook with candidate weight sets.
pavel: I'll draft the audit schema and the immutability plan. also will add beta-decay param for factual metric.
release-bot: noted. If fuzzy_gates enabled and risk_score > autofallback threshold -> page @oncall-release and require override for promote.
zoe: thanks team. scheduling a follow-up after retrospective completes. :thumbsup:
arjun: sounds good. tagging QA to watch the first two fuzzy-enabled preflight runs.\pavel: PR incoming in the next 2 business days.
